title: Press House Ledger
text:
Honey, spring pressing: 40 crocks. Wax, clean: 11 stone. Candles dipped for the chapel: 600.

The next page, in the same hand but pressed much harder:

Synod inspectors came. Took all 600 candles and burned them in the yard. Said beeswax is 'a light that asks nothing,' as if that were a sin.

The page after that is only a list of names, and a count of hives beside each one. Most of the counts have been struck through.
